title: ever POSIE|Gathered Chiffon Sleeveless Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Fresh and feminine, this Amber Bloom Print dress is designed to flatter with ease. The high neckline highlights the shoulders and collarbone, while the sleeveless cut keeps the look light and elegant. A defined waist shapes the silhouette, and the flowy high low hem adds graceful movement that helps the legs look longer. Perfect for weddings, garden parties, and other dressy daytime occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
